title: Ruth Paine's sister works for the CIA; Paine brings the Oswalds to Dallas

tellings.quote: Turns out her sister works for the CIA.

plain: In 1963 a woman named Ruth Paine is said to have brought Lee Harvey Oswald and his wife Marina from New Orleans to Dallas, and her sister worked for the CIA. Dan Sheehan, a guest who talks to Michels about the Kennedy assassination, tells it as something that "turns out" to be so. If true, it would put a CIA connection close to Oswald in the months before he shot Kennedy.
